title: Time Jump — 11:00 AM

fields.narration: Facilitator → All: It is now 11:00 AM. The yellow-green cloud over Rail Spot 2 has grown to 300 meters in diameter and is now visible from the city limits. Fence-line detector AT-905 remains active. The ERT has reached the loading rack and is preparing to manually close HV-312. The Triconex key switch is still in PROGRAM mode. The DCS shows ESD-310 closed, but the ERT confirms the hand valve HV-312 is open and the release continues. The shift must decide whether to trust the digital control system or take manual control under field authority.
